reviews.review: This is more missions for Sniper Elite 5 - if you enjoyed SE5 (like I did) then go for this one when on sale
I would recommend to fans of the series who want more , or who are new to the series, its a fine point to start off

A small "upgrade" over the previous game, with level design being more aimed towards long shots, which at the same time makes the game even easier than Sniper Elite 5 is

I wish Rebellion could put more effort into the Authentic difficulty, after SE4 it starts to go downhill.

Pants game ...
The level design is bad although a tiny bit better than SE5,
The controls are still clunky like SE5.
The white outline when hiding in the grass is still there ... no option to turn it off yet again!
The BIGGEST reason for my negative review though is the woke rewriting of history it is appalling and very disturbing!!! ... BAD BAD move Rebellion.
EDIT : The game is yet again another bad entry into the Sniper Elite game franchise.
I still do not recommend this game (even after 100 hours)

If you can pick it up heavily discounted ... £5 or less then may be it is worth the money.
My copy was a gift from a friend.
Fantastic game! I am really enjoying it so far. This is my first Sniper Elite experience and I have to say its been amazing!

Fantastic game but don't be foolled: this is basically SE 5 continuation. Oh, btw: play as Karl Fairburne. The "new character" is a disgrace. Terrible addiction. 

Karl Fairburne is already a classic, there's no Sniper Elite without it. I don't care about appearance or other irrelevant stuff; Fairburne IS THE CHARACTER that makes this game what it is. Original.

I don't know what Rebellion was thinking when decided to introduce a doofus as new option for a character that demand Gravitas and Dignitas  -- seriousness, substance and dignity, honor.
Seriously disappointed in this one. Loved the last two. This one just doesn't come together for many reasons.

The campaign is interesting and some variations in how a task can be completed. Having said that you are also forced to follow specific paths at times (gates closed but randomly open at later parts of a mission).

I played a little bit of SE:5 for "free" via PS Plus. I enjoyed it enough to try SE: Resistance, the newest title out at the moment. I really enjoy the mechanics of the game and the multiplayer.  You can turn "invasions" to "on / invite only / off". To get the grasps of the mechanics, I suggests keeping them off for the first 2 missions. If you do play with invasions on, I suggest using your quick save (F5), in case things go south. I like taking a stealthy approach, when you unlock more attachments and rifle ammo, it will be slightly easier to do at the start (The quick save also really helps).

I completed the game on Sniper Elite (Hard).  So far, I feel like I've seen just about everything at 30 hours in the game. However, it has yet to feel dull or boring. Overall, great game. I don't know why I put this series off for so long.
Bad copy of SE5. This is first Sniper Elite that is so doll, predictable.

So this is a odd review. The game itself is perfect. More Sniper Elite gameplay. Nice amount of weapons, maps and modes. So why the bad rating? My game crashed every few minutes and I find out why. Denvuo. Once I reinstalled the game without it installed, the crashing went away. I contacted Rebellion and they tried blaming my M.2 drive it was installed on. I mean, I do get maybe thats an issue, even if I don't understand how. But the fact anti-cheat software crashes a game at all is a big issue for me. Now if I want to play online, I can't. Because the game crashes. 

Only good news is I got the deluxe version for $40 at another site. So I'm not to mad, I'm getting my moneys worth at least single player. Which honestly is the biggest part for me.

-update-
After 156 hours now I can say the game kinda is boring now that I did everything. The online is a mixed bag though. Most of the modes have no one playing. The team mode where two teams face off on a small map seems to work. Sometimes you ever get a full lobby. So kinda fun. Though there are common people that most seems to hate for various reasons. Cheap tactics, quitting/joining the other side...etc. 

The funnest and yet most annoying mode is Axis Invasion where you join someone elses games as a nazi. In theory the mode can be fun when the other player does it right. But I'd say 75% of the games you join are people who cleared the map and set hundreds of traps everywhere while they tend to hide in a very hard to get to spot. Which not only makes it boring having to defuse endless traps (or be blown up), but having to try to get to them and dying dozens of times because they won't move. And its even worse when they have coop going as they can camp even harder.

Now, I'm for camping. It's a sniper game after all. But invaders have limited options to actually win. Limited ammo, you can't pick the ammo you want or the items you get. And past that the other player(s) have the special vision that lets them see you through walls. While you do not. Giving them even more edge. So camping back is harder. And the only real way to combat a trap map camper is to sit for an hour and wait for them to quit or get mad and come find you instead. Often making it easier to kill them because their emotions are high since you didn't get baited by them. 

I still enjoy playing the invasion mode and just learn to quit any game as soon as I see the map is fully clear. It's a sign its a trap map. It would really help if the camping timer was shorter and the range of it was bigger. Often you don't have to leave your spot but like 50 feet to make the timer reset. Or better yet maybe remove traps from invasion mode. Or limit them. Or maybe have a feature that if devs see someone is doing traps maps endlessly, maybe they get a strike on their account. 

And by that I mean maybe you now get spotted as soon as someone joins your game and it doesn't stop showing where you are. This way it at least gives the invader a better chance. I don't know, if they can fix the mode, the game would be funner. 

Outside of MP and invasion though, not much else to do. Except wait for the next game. And at this point with the game being a year old, the devs gave up on it.

-update 2-
Been mostly playing MP now. Only two modes in it every really have players, Team Mode (on a small map fighting each other). Or No Cross in which you each have part of a map and the other side can't cross over. While MP is fun for these two modes, people are apparently still able to use cheats despite Denvuo, all the more reason NOT to bother with denvuo. Past that people also love glitching. There are ways to fall under the map, glitched walls to shoot from, and other such things that let you kill people without them being able to do much.

ANd of course they still give you the silly ability to see through walls. Its very limited mind you. But still silly in MP. A good portion of players camp and use this vision to kill people.
